recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Trail Mix Bars
instructions: Line an 8 x 8 inch (21 x 21 cm) baking dish with parchment paper. Melt the chocolate in a microwave or on the stove, using a double boiler.
Pour half of the melted chocolate into the dish and spread it out into an even layer. Sprinkle about half of the almonds, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds over top.
Drizzle the remaining half of the chocolate over top, "sandwiching" the almonds and cranberries in the middle of the chocolate layers, using a rubber spatula to even out the top.
Sprinkle the top with the remaining ingredients. Place in the fridge or freezer for 10 to 20 minutes to harden.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in an airtight container at room temperature or in the fridge for up to 1 month.
